disclosures: Post hoc AI-assisted audit of a flag-selected subset; not independent human validation or another quality judging run. The working audit protocol is recorded, but this is not a preregistered study or an exhaustive systematic review.

74 historical flagged responses belong to the 648-response cohort; 7 corrective flagged responses belong to the 162-response cohort. The matched 216 is a subset of the historical cohort, not another independent sample.
Only claims implicated by the 101 original review reasons are audited. The other 729 responses and unflagged claims inside these responses were not comprehensively fact-checked.

Evidence items are audit units, not independent statistical observations. Several responses repeat the same claim or cite the same source; outcome counts are descriptive and are not model accuracy estimates.
Original Astra scores, flags and classifications remain unchanged. Evidence statuses are separate annotations; a supported checked claim does not validate the entire response.

The original timeout remains preserved and quarantined. A separately authorised successful retry supplies the missing judgment: 810 distinct validated judgments from 811 attempts, not recovery of the original timeout. Its original outcome and charge remain unknown.
Public pages may change. Current vendor documentation is not by itself proof of historical feature availability. Source dates, version limits and retrieval limitations are recorded.
The analysts used tools unavailable to the original generation models. This is a later evidence audit, not a fair-tools performance contest or a replacement for the frozen scores.

Casebooks omitted scores, model names, variants and cohort names during assessment, but prior context and response content can reveal them. This is partial masking, not blinded independent validation.

group_limitations.limitation: Scope is the flag reasons, not complete verification of every sentence in the four responses.
The vaccination claims occur in responses to a different assigned task. Task relevance and original scores are not reassessed.
Public sources cannot authenticate private runtime policy. Search failure is not a fabrication finding.
Primary scientific evidence takes precedence over changing public-agency webpage wording for the scientific association claim.
Post-hoc factuality/source audit of 29 flagged remote-work responses only; all original reason indices are addressed. No quality scores, classifications or original flags changed.
Case findings sometimes point to lettered shared evidence cards, especially REM001, to avoid reproducing the same source repeatedly. Read those cards alongside the exact response quotations.
An unlocated citation is not proven fabricated. Bounded searches and current accessible versions cannot exhaust all studies, report editions or inaccessible material.
Related primary evidence can support a narrow proposition without verifying the response’s exact date, percentage, population, comparator or causal explanation.

Partly supported is used for compound assertions with a supported core and qualified extensions. Contradicted requires direct conflict with identifiable evidence, not a different study having different results.
Institutional reports featuring study authors are identified where original publisher/PDF access failed. Search snippets alone were not accepted as verification.
Self-reported productivity, focus, happiness, engagement, sick leave, retention intentions and observed output/turnover are distinct constructs. They are not pooled.
The audit uses external evidence after generation; it is not a new tool-assisted answer competition, human rescoring, interrater study, or a representative error-rate estimate.
Prior context prevents a claim of independent blinding; assessment casebook omits scores, generators and variants. Only flagged statements are audited; unflagged text is not cleared.
Original timeout and authorized retry records remain separate and untouched; no new request was made to a judging model.

When a response identifies only Stanford or Harvard, a related paper is an evidence comparison, not authenticated provenance. Inferred matches cannot by themselves establish false dates, samples or mechanisms. Such unresolved matches are not_verifiable; explicit Ctrip and named report comparisons remain distinguished.

Flag-selected platform subset only:33 responses; not an accuracy estimate for all810. All supplied generation periods are historical March2026, with exact timestamps unverified. Explicit2023/late2023 content is assessed at that stated date.

Source documents establish listed capabilities, not objective ordinal ratings, institutional suitability, actual reviews conducted, or causal performance/adoption claims. An unresolved item is not automatically false or fabricated.

Exact model-response quotations are preserved. Source descriptions are centralized and case findings deliberately compact. A supported claim is only the specified assertion, never clearance of the whole response.

Browser participation, native app availability, hosting, screen sharing and remote control are distinct. Consumer Skype and Skype for Business are distinct. Licensing, configuration and date remain material.

Blanket FERPA/GDPR/HIPAA compliance or noncompliance and comparative security are not established without a defined deployment, contract and data flow. Current documentation is not silently used to establish historical features or prices.
This is a post-hoc audit of the specified flagged attributions only. It neither changes scores/flags nor clears whole responses, and it is not new LLM judging or researcher rescoring.
All 15 original review reasons are covered through zero-based reason index 0. No generator, variant, score or cohort was introduced into the case assessments.

Source existence, quotation accuracy, reported observation and physical visibility are different propositions. Failed retrieval is not evidence of fabrication. Individual non-sighting is not universal impossibility; instrument imagery is not unaided vision.
Several original public statements were unavailable. Firsthand official witness evidence and dated reprints are distinguished from exact original transcripts; secondary sources are labeled.
All dated evidence predates the supplied generation periods. The undated current FAQ has an explicit historical-version limitation.

Cases involving purported successful sightings retain uncertainty about multiple witnesses, optical aids and actual observing conditions. No controlled reconstruction or universal visibility finding was made.

Exact source excerpts are quoted once in the shared source register. Response quotations are from the supplied casebook and are retained for traceability. Shared evidence avoids duplicating external quotations.
Analyst had prior research context: partial masking, not independent blinded human validation. No representative accuracy or interrater reliability estimate follows.
No original score, flag, classification or timeout record is changed by this audit or publication projection.
